messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — p99 latency SLO burn detected for service=runtime-api (us-west). Metric: p99 > 1.2s over 5m. Pager: PD#12345.

devon: acked. I'm on it.

samir: looking at traces now, grabbing flamegraphs + tail latencies.

maria: same — dashboards show a sudden p99 jump ~3m ago coincident with a KV-cache eviction surge on sidecar-2a.

jeff: any deploys in last 10m? CI bot shows no deploys.}

devon: not seeing deploys. autoscaler bumped pods ~7m ago, might have triggered cache churn.

samir: logs: lots of `kvcache.Evict` and `rpc.Reconnect` spikes. Could be hotkey causing uneven memoization.

maria: customer-impact?

devon: initial check: error rate stable, but enterprise customers hitting timeout SLO alerts. ACME support pinged SRE. Not full outage but degraded tail latency.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page escalated to oncall-2 (rotation) — awaiting ack.

oncall-2: acked. hopping in.

samir: quick mitigation idea: route high-rqps routes to model-variant-lowmem which has smaller KV usage and avoid sidecar eviction.

maria: +1. Also can temporarily reduce batch size to 1 for runtime-api to avoid long headwaits while we stabilize caches.

devon: I can flip routing via console API. Running the change as a canary (10% traffic) first. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/routes/route-123/override \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \ 
  -d '{"route_percent":10, "target_model":"model-variant-lowmem"}'
```

samir: I'll watch p95/p99 and traces. Maria, can you coordinate support message to ACME (short blurb)?

maria: on it — sending a quick note: "We are investigating increased tail latency; no customer-facing errors, temporary routing changes in progress. We'll update in 15 mins."

incident-bot: Alert update: canary change applied (10% to model-variant-lowmem). Metrics ingesting...

samir: early signal: canary p99 down ~30% on the canary subset. Good.

devon: rolling to 50% now. Command: `redwoodctl rollout --route route-123 --target model-variant-lowmem --percent 50`

jeff: heads-up: reducing batch size might increase token cost. Ok with that for now?

maria: confirmed with customer ops — they prefer availability over cost. Proceed.

samir: 50% rollout stable for 2mins, p99 trending down cluster-wide now.

devon: pushing to 100%. `redwoodctl rollout --route route-123 --target model-variant-lowmem --percent 100`

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD#12345 acknowledged and resolved (mitigation applied).

maria: support note updated: "Mitigation applied; tail latency reduced. We will monitor and follow up with RCA."

jeff: created short-lived mitigation runbook snippet in #eng-docs: `kvcache-hotkey-mitigations` — will expand.

samir: follow-ups: 1) investigate hotkey detection + auto-evict tuning, 2) autoscaler smoothing to avoid mass evictions, 3) consider KV cache size bump for sidecar-2a class.

devon: handing off to oncall-2 for post-incident monitoring and RCA. oncall-2 — please take ownership for the next 2 hours.

oncall-2: taking ownership. I'll watch dashboards and coordinate a short RCA in the morning. Will also add ACME follow-up timeline.

maria: thanks all. Quick recap for the PD log: mitigation routing to model-variant-lowmem, reduced batch size, rollback not required.

jeff: adding task: `ENG-7891` for autoscaler smoothing + `ENG-7892` for kvcache heuristics.

samir: we should capture sample traces and the hotkey keyspace for postmortem. I'll export traces to S3.

devon: closing thread here — if anyone sees re-escalation, ping PD. Good job. :thumbsup:

oncall-2: acknowledged handoff. I'll post a short incident summary in #incidents in 1hr.

maria: +1 — will draft the ACME email for review.

incident-bot: Thread closed by devon (mitigation applied).
